messages:
jordan (AE): Helion (prospect) sent an RFP. They want a feature-by-feature capability matrix + sample private deploy contract language. Main asks: FIPS HSM, SOC2 + pen test dates, and a throughput SLA for ~6k reqs/min sustained. Can we turn around by Thursday?
lee (Solutions Engineer): I can assemble the matrix. Need to confirm if Helion considers 'KV caching' and 'prompt prefix caching' as separate rows or grouped. Also: do they need multi-region failover?
nora (SRE): For sustained 6k/min we should size for 15% headroom. With a 7B quantized model that's ~3x fewer GPUs than a 13B, but accuracy tradeoffs matter. I'll add two capacity scenarios in the doc.
pavan (Security): FIPS HSM is doable but we need to know vendor preference. If they require HSM-on-prem we must specify customer-run appliance + our KMS proxy pattern. Also will flag that on-prem SLA is contingent on customer infra.
kim (Legal): For the sample contract language I'll share a small clause pack: key ownership, no-retention of plaintext, mutual TLS, breach notification timeline. Anything else to include?
jordan (AE): They explicitly asked for a clause about proof of secure deletion of KV caches after POC. Add that.
lee (Solutions Engineer): Will add a POC acceptance row: throughput >= 6k reqs/min, median latency < 120ms for 256 tokens, and 99% availability during test window. Also include fallback to smaller model if quality drop > 3% on their eval set.
nora (SRE): I'll paste a sample private-deploy manifest (ops):
```
network:
  vpc_peer: yes
  subnets: 3
compute:
  gpus: 8
  instance_type: a10g
kms:
  mode: hsm-proxy
  mtls: enabled
```
Use as an example; final numbers in the matrix.
pavan (Security): Security bullets to include in matrix: - HSM key custody (customer) - HSM vendor support list - FIPS validation status - Audit log granularity (per-request) - Retention windows and erasure proof - Pen test date + scope
kim (Legal): Also include export controls / data residency row. Helion is EU-based, they want data residency within EU for the POC.
jordan (AE): Helion timeline: vendor short-list wanted by Thur EOD, POC kickoff next Tue. Tight but possible. I'll coordinate demo times.
lee (Solutions Engineer): I'll produce the capability matrix with these columns: Feature | Supported | Notes | Customer risk | Attachments. Will mark any "requires custom eng" cells.
nora (SRE): For SLA language: we can offer a 99.5% platform SLA for Dedicated; for Private we can offer support SLAs for our agents and a best-effort availability for customer infra. I'll add a caveat line.
pavan (Security): Add our recent pen test date: 2025-11-02, SOC2 Type II completed 2026-01-15. Also note we can provide redacted reports under NDA.
lee (Solutions Engineer): Pricing sketch for matrix row: - POC engineering fee: $30k - Minimum reserved monthly: $18k (for EU deployment size) - Burst multiplier 1.5x on top of reserved. Mark as indicative.
jordan (AE): Uploading Helion RFP here: https://files.redwood-internal/helion/helion-rfp-2026.pdf :paperclip:
upload-bot: File uploaded: helion-rfp-2026.pdf (link: https://files.redwood-internal/helion/helion-rfp-2026.pdf)
lee (Solutions Engineer): I uploaded draft matrix v0.1 and a one-page POC outline: https://files.redwood-internal/helion/helion-matrix-v0.1.xlsx and https://files.redwood-internal/helion/helion-poc-onepager.pdf
pavan (Security): Quick note on HSM modes: - Cloud-managed KMS + external HSM partner (acceptable) - Pure air-gapped HSM (customer provides) requires extra engineering and cannot use our control-plane updates. Call that out.
kim (Legal): I'll prepare a short "sample clauses" doc and attach by EOD.
jordan (AE): Great. I'll coordinate the Thur short-list delivery. Who can join the customer call Monday 10am CET? Lee + Nora + Pavan?
lee (Solutions Engineer): I can.
nora (SRE): I'll join.
pavan (Security): I'll join for the technical security Qs.
jordan (AE): Thanks team 44d Keep bullets crisp for the customer deliverable (they want a 1-2 page matrix + one pager POC).
